name: Unified Interface & Entry Points
description: The product surface — a single async class (Apprentice) that accepts a task name + input dict and returns a typed TaskResponse. The caller has zero visibility into routing, phases, or which model produced the answer. Also includes the CLI entry point (apprentice CLI command) that loads config, boots all components via dependency injection, and provides subcommands: 'run' (start serving), 'status' (show current phase/confidence/budget per task), 'report' (generate full report). Library entry point: 'from apprentice import Apprentice' for programmatic use. Constructor takes config path, wires all components together. The Apprentice class is the composition root — it constructs and injects all dependencies. Structured across five files: types.py (~250 lines, all Pydantic models and enums), errors.py (~60 lines, exception hierarchy), core.py (~120 lines, Apprentice class), cli.py (~170 lines, CLI entry point and subcommand dispatch), __init__.py (~10 lines, public re-exports).

functions.name: run
functions.description: Primary public method. Executes a task: looks up the task in the registry, creates a RunContext, queries confidence and budget state, routes to appropriate model backend (local or remote), handles fallbacks, records spend, stores training data, flushes the audit log entry, and returns a frozen TaskResponse. The caller has zero visibility into routing logic. Error decision matrix: (1) local_available=T, budget_available=T → route normally; (2) local_available=T, budget_available=F → local-only, log warning, status=degraded; (3) local_available=F, budget_available=T → remote-only with fallback cost; (4) local_available=F, budget_available=F → raise BudgetExhaustedError or LocalModelUnavailableError.

inputs.description: Name of the task to execute. Must match a task registered in the task registry.

invariants: self._config is always a fully validated, frozen ApprenticeConfig instance after __init__ completes
self._running is True if and only if the async context has been entered and not yet exited
run() and status() always raise RuntimeError if self._running is False

All 10 internal components are non-None after __init__ completes: _config_loader, _task_registry, _remote_client, _local_client, _confidence_engine, _sampling_scheduler, _budget_manager, _training_data_store, _router, _audit_log
Budget enforcement is hard: if budget_manager.can_spend() returns False for a task, no remote API call is made for that task
Every run() invocation creates exactly one RunContext, which is flushed to the audit log on completion regardless of success or failure
TaskResponse.source accurately reflects which model backend produced the output — never misattributed
Phase labels are always derived from confidence scores and thresholds — never manually assigned or overridden
Sampling rate is continuous (float in [0.0, 1.0]), never discrete tiers
All return types (TaskResponse, ConfidenceSnapshot, SystemReport) are frozen Pydantic v2 models — immutable after construction
No global state: all state flows through explicit parameters, injected dependencies, or instance attributes
Local model failure with available budget triggers graceful fallback to remote — never crashes
Budget exhaustion with available local model triggers graceful degradation to local-only — never crashes
Only when BOTH local model is unavailable AND budget is exhausted does the system raise an error
Component overrides provided in __init__ completely replace the default-constructed component — no partial merging
SystemReport.total_runs always equals SystemReport.total_local_runs + SystemReport.total_remote_runs
close() is idempotent — safe to call multiple times with no side effects after the first call
asyncio.run() is called exactly once per CLI main() invocation, never nested
CLI exit codes are deterministic: 0 for success, 1 for application/config error, 2 for usage error, 130 for keyboard interrupt
Config validation errors always fail at startup, never silently default
All CLI output goes to stdout; all errors and logs go to stderr
Structured JSON logging is configured before any other work in CLI main()
ConfidenceThresholds must satisfy: bootstrapping_upper < active_learning_upper < supervised_upper <= autonomous_lower
All enums use StrEnum except ExitCode which uses IntEnum
Source files respect the 300-line limit: types.py ~250 lines, errors.py ~60 lines, core.py ~120 lines, cli.py ~170 lines, __init__.py ~10 lines
